title: Cute Toys - Training Treats
text:
I had mixed feelings about this subscription. The toys were cute but the treats were like training treats and I had the 50+ lb. dog subscription. I don't know about other people's dogs but my larger sized dog inhales those small tidbits like an appetizer to the main course. I need a bully stick to slow him down.
Be warned, it's nearly impossible to cancel this subscription. I wrote to them, through Amazon, at the beginning of Oct. and also Nov., even though the Oct cancellation notification should have been over 30 days, I still received a shipment in the middle of November.
They did not respond to my cancellation requests. Today I called Amazon and the gentleman on the phone was able to cancel the subscription for me.
I was aware that this might be a problem but had thought it would have been managed. I was wrong. So heads up.
label: neutral
